title: Photocatalysis & Solar Energy Conversion
desc: Design of visible-light-driven heterogeneous photocatalysts via structural modification and composite engineering for hydrogen evolution and selective oxidation.

title: Wastewater Remediation
desc: Advanced oxidation processes and photocatalytic systems for the treatment of industrial effluents, dye removal, and emerging micropollutants in water bodies.

title: Circular Economy & Waste Valorization
desc: Converting industrial by-products and natural waste streams into functional photocatalytic materials — closing the loop between pollution and resource recovery.

title: CO₂ Capture & Utilization
desc: Developing catalytic pathways for carbon dioxide valorization into value-added chemicals and fuels as part of a broader net-zero engineering strategy.

title: Electronic Waste Recovery
desc: Green hydrometallurgical and photochemical processes for selective extraction of precious metals from end-of-life batteries and printed circuit boards.

title: Biomass Conversion
desc: Photo(electro)catalytic conversion of lignocellulosic biomass into platform chemicals, contributing to sustainable bio-based feedstock production.
